_comment: Advisory trigger evals — deterministic keyword match, not merge-gating. Should-trigger: auditing the ads the user's OWN company is running, what they cover, what they stopped, what is holding or fatiguing. Should-not-trigger: competitors' ads (researching-competitor-ads), the brand's identity (analyzing-brand), a product's facts (analyzing-products), deciding what to make next (planning-campaigns), generating creative, and an off-topic control. Research only — run lengths from the public library, never spend or results.
